artworks.title: Soldier Thrown in Air
artworks.description: This black-and-white photograph shows a group of men in dark shirts with dark, wide-brimmed hats. Everyone is gathered outdoors near some pointed gray tents, and they appear to be in a loose circle, holding a tarp or cloth stretched out between them. One man appears to float in the air above the group, his body horizontal, facing the right. The men below him are all smiling widely, some appearing to laugh. In the bottom left corner, one man looks back over his shoulder at us, a white cigarette in his mouth. Most of the men appear to have light skin, although some are in shadow. The sky behind the tents and floating man is bright white.

artworks.title: Study of the Spires of Lichfield Cathedral
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a gothic-style cathedral with three tall, pointed spires against a darkened sky. The cathedral features detailed stonework, arched windows, and intricate designs. Two buildings frame the cathedral in the foreground. The contrast highlights the architectural details against the dark background.

artworks.title: Bas-Bréau, Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland path with tall trees on both sides. The viewpoint is from the ground looking straight ahead along the narrowing path. The canopy of leaves overhead nearly obscures the high horizon line. The tree trunks cast shadows, and sunlight filters through the leaves onto the ground. The photograph lacks distinct brushstrokes giving it a painterly effect. The color palette is primarily sepia tones, with shades of deep browns and soft golds. In the distance, the path continues into the forest.

artworks.title: Ange Portant un Cadran Solaire, à l'Eglise de Chartres
artworks.description: The sculpture features an angelic figure with wings partially spread out, affixed to a stone wall. The angel holds a sundial with a triangular gnomon casting a shadow. The figure wears flowing robes, a decorative halo-like feature above the head, and stands on a short pedestal. The sculpture is made of stone, blending into the same-colored wall backdrop with a rough texture. The natural, earthy tone of the stone appears weathered and aged. The sculpture is part of an architectural structure, with a small arched feature above the angel’s head, suggesting integration into the building's design.

artworks.title: Salle des Cariatides, au Musée du Louvre
artworks.description: The image shows a hall filled with classical sculptures, mostly human figures. The sculptures are light-colored, possibly made from marble. Several statues of draped female figures stand symmetrically against the walls, while a nude male statue stands on a pedestal in the foreground. The hall features architectural elements like columns and arched ceilings adorned with intricate carvings. Light streams in from the left, illuminating the space and highlighting the detailed features of the sculptures.

artworks.title: The Seine from the Pont du Carrousel Looking towards Notre Dame
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from the bank of a river with historic buildings across the water. A cobblestone street runs alongside trees and small structures, leading the eye towards distant buildings and bridges. The horizon is marked by the cityscape's architectural silhouette, including the prominent dome of an ornate building. A bridge spans the river, connecting to more distant buildings. The photograph is in sepia tones, creating a vintage feel. The color palette includes earthy browns and muted grays, contributing to a timeless and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bois de Boulogne
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water reflecting trees along its banks. Two trees stand near the water's edge, with sparse branches. The horizon sits low, with an expansive sky blending into distant foliage. A small bridge crosses the water. The image has a sepia tone with a color palette of browns and grays. The sky has a gentle gradient, contrasting with the defined silhouettes of trees and landscape.

artworks.title: Rue des Lombards, from the rue des Lavandières Sainte-Opportune
artworks.description: The image is a black and white photograph of an urban street scene. The perspective leads the viewer down a central cobblestone street flanked by tall buildings. The horizon is formed by the converging street, with buildings extending into the distance. Architectural details like shuttered windows and facades suggest a classic European cityscape. Signage on buildings displays business names and addresses. A small pushcart is parked by the sidewalk, and a horse-drawn carriage is visible further down the street. The monochrome palette adds a timeless quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Plate Number 34. Walking and carrying a 15-lb. basket on head, hands raised
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing sequential frames of a figure walking with a basket on its head. The image displays different stages of the walking motion in each frame. The figure is seen in profile in the top row and from the back in the bottom row, set against a grid background. The sequence highlights the dynamic movement, focusing on posture and balance needed to carry the basket. The study captures the rhythm and continuity of the walk, emphasizing movement and anatomy in a scientific manner.

artworks.title: Asile Impérial de Vincennes: le 15 Août, le Salut à l'Empereur
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a ceremonial gathering in front of a grand building entrance. The image shows a group of individuals arranged in a semi-circle facing towards the camera. Some are standing on the steps leading to a large arched doorway. The building's facade is detailed with brickwork and decorative elements around the doorway. Many individuals are holding or waving hats in the air. The crowd includes people in various attires such as dark suits and lighter clothing. The photograph captures a historical moment and the architecture and clothing styles indicate the time period. A gravel path is visible leading up to the steps, and the overall tone of the image is sepia.

artworks.title: Asile Impérial de Vincennes: la Lingerie
artworks.description: Two women are shown standing in a hallway lined with shelves filled with papers. Both women wear traditional nun habits and appear engaged in their surroundings. The hallway is well-lit with sunlight streaming in from windows, casting shadows.

artworks.title: Statue des Tuileries: G. Marsy et A. Flamen: Borée enlevant Orythie
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts three intertwined human figures in a moment of intense action. The central figure is a muscular male with large feathered wings, lifting a partially draped female figure and reaching upwards. Below them, another male figure is depicted in a struggling pose. The sculpture is crafted from marble and shows detailed anatomical features, capturing movement and interaction. It is set against an outdoor backdrop with classical architectural elements visible.

artworks.title: Shoshone Falls, Snake River, Idaho
Forest at Saint-Cloud
artworks.description: The image shows a forest with tall trees, viewed from a low angle. The horizon is hidden by the thick tree canopy. A pathway leads into the forest and a person stands among the trees. The image has a monochromatic and sepia tone, creating a warm and earthy atmosphere. The presence of shadows and glimpses of light filtering through the trees add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Absalom's Tomb, Valley of Kidron, Jerusalem
artworks.description: The image shows a weathered stone structure, potentially a tomb or monument, on the right side. The upper section has intricate carvings and columns, with an aged texture and spots of vegetation. The ground is covered in stones, leading to hilly terrain in the distance. The horizon is visible near the top edge, with tree silhouettes against a bright sky. The color palette is muted with sepia tones, giving an antique quality to the image.

artworks.title: Lace
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 17.1 x 22 cm (6 3/4 x 8 11/16 in.)
support: 24.8 x 31.1 cm (9 3/4 x 12 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a piece of delicate lace with an intricate floral and vine pattern against a dark background. The color palette includes white lace against varying shades of gray and sepia tones, giving a vintage appearance. The lace is positioned centrally, extending horizontally with floral patterns concentrated towards the lower part and a simpler mesh design covering the upper portion.

artworks.title: Espagne. Seville, Cour de la Maison Du Duc De Medina Celi dite Maison de Pilate
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a historic courtyard. It features a lavish architectural courtyard with a central fountain and a series of arched columns lining the perimeter. The details highlight intricate tile and stonework commonly associated with traditional Spanish or Moorish architecture. The fountain in the middle of the courtyard boasts a sculptural centerpiece, and surrounding it are lush potted plants. The two-tiered structure is adorned with decorative latticework and features a roof with patterned shingles.

artworks.title: Rangoon: Great Bell of the Shwe Dagon Pagoda
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view with a prominent tree slightly off-center to the right. The horizon is obstructed by tall trees and structures surrounding the area. On the left, architectural features such as spires and rooftops can be seen among the greenery. The image appears to have a vintage style, possibly sepia-toned. The overall color scheme is limited to shades of brown and dark tones. The tree in the foreground is lush, casting shade, while a structure with a large bell is partially visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Tanjore: Great Pagoda, Entrance Looking Outwards
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 27.2 x 34.7 cm (10 11/16 x 13 11/16 in.)
support: 45.6 x 57.5 cm (17 15/16 x 22 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone structure with intricate carvings, statues, and ornate details. The view is slightly elevated, emphasizing the depth and architectural grandeur of the building. The structure is surrounded by leafless trees with slender trunks. The color palette is sepia, creating a warm, antique appearance. The scene lacks vivid colors, focusing on textures and shadows. The ground is paved, suggesting an entryway or courtyard.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees and Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge over a narrow stream, surrounded by tall trees. The bridge divides the view horizontally, featuring worn wooden planks and a simple railing. The thick clusters of trees frame the image, creating a natural canopy. Stones and pebbles line the stream's banks, with water flowing gently. The scene has a monochromatic palette of brown and sepia, giving it an antiquated and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Les Salles des Gardes, Palais des Papes, Avignon, France
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an empty dormitory or barracks room. The image captures a long, narrow space lined with rows of single metal-framed beds on either side, each finished with neatly folded blankets and clothing hanging beside them. In the center of the room, two parallel lines of large pillars extend from the floor to the ceiling. Suspended from the ceiling are simple light fixtures. The architecture of the room features high, arched ceilings. The overall setting appears methodical and orderly, with personal belongings organized along the beds, such as uniforms and bags. The black and white tone of the photograph suggests a historical setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Hand
artworks.description: The image shows an up-close view of a person's hand. The hand is positioned with the back facing the viewer and fingers slightly bent, relaxed, against a flat surface. The skin appears smooth. There are no specific facial features or hair visible. The image does not display any clothing. The background is plain and likely composed of a neutral, slightly textured surface behind the hand.

artworks.title: Maison de la Belle Jardinière
artworks.description: The image shows an urban construction scene with wheelbarrows lined up on a construction site. Multi-story buildings with a prominent structure featuring signage reading "MAISON DE LA BELLE JARDINIERE" are visible in the background. The sepia-toned image lacks a visible natural horizon line, focusing on the architectural details against a uniform sky.

artworks.title: Cuissard et Jambière du Roi Henri II
artworks.description: The image displays two ornate pieces of armor against a brown backdrop. The armor has intricate etchings and is of muted grays. The taller armored boot is on the left and a slightly shorter piece with engraved detailing is on the right, partially overlapping the taller boot. Both pieces are on a dark surface.
